## Design

### 2026-11-05: Day 1: Polish Design Idea and Start CAD

**3.5h**

Day 1: Polish Design Idea and Start CAD

Today I worked on my design idea and CAD.

Basically, my design is something that can turn on the light for me without me getting out of bed. My primary concern was the way to mount it to the wall, because if it stained the wall, my mum would get real mad at me. I decided to use some Command tape (I don't know the official name):

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/wqTzuosjo4Cs9kmuI53ss6gj7yDmRmwn/c5d58b5f2e1e080a47b3bac4cc3e896bcd3902079a4c5d4463e459af47377c18.png)

Then,  I started working on my BOM. For my project, I knew I wanted some mechanism to lift the light, but I wasn't sure how. I was debating between a pulley system and a physical rack and pinion when I came up with this:

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/wqTzuosjo4Cs9kmuI53ss6gj7yDmRmwn/b6d6db2b16e4133529fb279c9dfc4567121f17406f20c4e33167e2cc4f3f33f1.png)

The idea is to have a wheel with spokes that pushes the light switch on and off. For this, you need decent torque, so I ordered the MG90S, a metal-gear servo motor.

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/wqTzuosjo4Cs9kmuI53ss6gj7yDmRmwn/5decf3f2e67e34b78fb6ccf6638fc9ab557e7e2660d142fb2149c47702255a08.png)

Then, I realized that I had run out of wires to use at my home for projects, so I needed to some wire, so I put an order for a roll of solid-core wire.

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/wqTzuosjo4Cs9kmuI53ss6gj7yDmRmwn/bf08638f508be0cf2fae381fd0d7db1b16b19736cdcda5501881abc7cdd1b06c.png)

I alse needed an IR module so I could turn it on and off remotely:

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/wqTzuosjo4Cs9kmuI53ss6gj7yDmRmwn/55635c4d23202a61e12b639f9d729d0b9062ca75bca7e36a3c297b5f13857308.png)

And a power cable for power:

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/wqTzuosjo4Cs9kmuI53ss6gj7yDmRmwn/c0a085bd8d395b157f169a8bfe20b7bf5409148e26c94f7d9d653b1ce50a0446.png)

Then I started on my CAD. I did not get much done because V1 was expensive, so I slimmed it down, and I need to start working on the finer aspects of it

### 2026-11-07: Day 2: CAD - Actual Poop

**5.5h**

Day 2: CAD - Actual Poop

So today I had to work on my CAD models, and it took an extremely long amount of time because online CAD shippers actually suck with the amount of $ it costs to get a part.

I started with a basic shape:

![Screenshot 2026-11-05 072954](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/wqTzuosjo4Cs9kmuI53ss6gj7yDmRmwn/3fbd906846606a8d8ede79c7a1645e88be902cd6b2158ad6c4fc121e7d7fb212.png)

It was held to the wall by command tape and had a little notch where the motor needed to go.

Then, I needed to start tuning the spacing for the motor placement. I used this helpful little guide I found on Reddit for all of the measurements:

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/wqTzuosjo4Cs9kmuI53ss6gj7yDmRmwn/ad34d87e5b4fa9f85058ef1bc9095026773423073d487679ec84646d272e5655.png)

I used these measurements to get the exact hole measurements:

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/wqTzuosjo4Cs9kmuI53ss6gj7yDmRmwn/97986e305094fcbc5ce72c1c6011faaaca302cbb6442941ffe287e72e334b2ee.png)

Then, I worked on the rest of the body and finished that.

Then I worked getting the actual servo onto the body:

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/wqTzuosjo4Cs9kmuI53ss6gj7yDmRmwn/a9a8f754f523d812b966ded2d818f8097e8db7ca6efb0dc55401446972bc9c35.png)

and then got the arm on the servo:

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/wqTzuosjo4Cs9kmuI53ss6gj7yDmRmwn/87e63a3e4e18ef609169d6f6e02d7edf8b52a406e1ba2885e7a9e7b4bd80d754.png)

Then I made the part that will actually turn on and off the light:

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/wqTzuosjo4Cs9kmuI53ss6gj7yDmRmwn/0eb265193f6f4ee83ae577c291a827ac31063ab86f770c7cdf524d7e8380b173.png)

I attached this to the servo, but the measurements were off, so I spent quite some time trying to fix that.

Then I submitted my design to JLC3DP, and i was greeted by a disguisting creature of man called an invoice:

![Screenshot 2026-11-07 113605](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/wqTzuosjo4Cs9kmuI53ss6gj7yDmRmwn/c09817b2b256b4fa25b0369410e38b8f4f60ab0fb8e7bdd1ce96754a27ccabb3.png)

I was actually livid. This was a simple $3 off budget. So I took out quite a lot of material

![Screenshot 2026-11-07 204525](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/wqTzuosjo4Cs9kmuI53ss6gj7yDmRmwn/c158da5c2ff79f5e3664d0e424150063dfdcb6bf41872b51c3a706bc7fa771bc.png)

![Screenshot 2026-11-07 204552](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/wqTzuosjo4Cs9kmuI53ss6gj7yDmRmwn/c48406a1e13459f1fb9a4936bd95fd4e7b49d6e82e96bab1bc4a8d030eed5001.png)

Even this was not enoughm, so I took out more:

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/wqTzuosjo4Cs9kmuI53ss6gj7yDmRmwn/7067a4b530e61e5456af538bddb01afcaab13a87b53da29e5820cf121deb0f1b.png)

Finally, I created the standoff:

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/wqTzuosjo4Cs9kmuI53ss6gj7yDmRmwn/210418e413a47f15fc2018758755d9e0a2ae190a40d227d825305d15544c5faf.png)
